Generate shell completions for zsh.

To enable zsh completions for this program add following line to your ~/.zshrc:

    source <(linear completions zsh)

Usage: linear completions zsh [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -n, --name <command-name>
          The name of the main command.

      --workspace <slug>
          Target workspace (uses credentials)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
